summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting and the engagement of ICP Securities Inc. as a market maker. The meeting re-elected directors, approved an auditor and equity plans, and designated Paul Andre Huet as Chair. Director William Hayden did not stand for re-election, a routine board transition. The market-maker agreement is for four months at C$7,500/month, with no shares or options. This filing contains ordinary corporate governance and liquidity provisions, not a special situation.
